name: Amorous
source:
Amorous is an adults only furry dating sim where you can meet and romance your dream furry date.
Create your own OC as either a human or custom furry species and test your charisma skills by exploring and approaching various characters, each with their own story progression and intimate scenes that you can unlock by completing all of their date paths!

[From [url=https://teamamorous.itch.io/amorous]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Amorous是一款仅限成人的毛茸茸约会模拟游戏，你可以在这里遇见并浪漫你梦想中的毛茸茸的约会对象。
创建你自己的OC作为人类或自定义毛茸茸的物种，并通过探索和接近各种角色来测试你的魅力技能，每个角色都有自己的故事进程和亲密场景，你可以通过完成他们的所有约会路径来解锁！

[来自[url=https://teamamorous.itch.io/amorous]Itch.io[/url]]
